name: shop-siren~p2
task: Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the task is a pure 'whenever' rule — each ring must be followed by a switch toggle, on that step or later. Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) hard captures it; no goal is commanded, so the rule-only warning and empty FINAL_STATES are valid.

texts: Each time the siren is ringing, the siren switch must be toggled.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled) -> u1
(u1, switch_toggled) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled, u1) -> -1
(u1, switch_toggled, u0) -> 1
